items.rationale: Rows 2 and 5 are both Nairobi and Sneakers: 120 + 95 = 215.
Kisumu appears only with Sandals in this list, so no row meets both conditions. SUMIFS then returns 0, not an error.
SUMIFS starts with sum_range, then lists criteria_range and criteria in pairs. SUMIF is different: its sum range is the optional last argument.

SUMIFS needs every condition to be true on the same row (AND). In the training table only row 3 is both Nairobi and Sandals, so the result is 45K, not the total of all Nairobi rows or of all Sandals rows.
